crossRefs.note: How long, Yahweh? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?
How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart every day? How long shall my enemy triumph over me?
Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for Yahweh holds him up with his hand.
God, why have you rejected us forever? Why does your anger smolder against the sheep of your pasture?
But you have rejected and spurned. You have been angry with your anointed.
How long, Yahweh? Will you hide yourself forever? Will your wrath burn like fire?
Can anyone hide himself in secret places so that I can’t see him?” says Yahweh. “Don’t I fill heaven and earth?” says…
For the Lord will not cast off forever.
For though he causes grief, yet he will have compassion according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.
I ask then, did God reject his people? May it never be! For I also am an Israelite, a descendant of Abraham, of the…
God didn’t reject his people, which he foreknew. Or don’t you know what the Scripture says about Elijah? How he pleads…
How long, Yahweh? Will you be angry forever? Will your jealousy burn like fire?
Yahweh, you have been favorable to your land. You have restored the fortunes of Jacob.
Will you be angry with us forever? Will you draw out your anger to all generations?
